meta.name: Walmart — High Cost of Low Prices
meta.description: Walmart is an iconic American company, known worldwide for selling cheap retail goods. While economists and global marketers call Walmart a success, there are many stories of mistreatment of employees, and a general feeling of mistrust and discontent among the businesses it has destroyed, such as local community stores.Walmart — High Cost Of Low Priceshighlights that it is worth being aware of the labour, social and corporate governance practices of companies that you do business with…
